subject: general
question: What is an Azolla?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fern**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It helps in weed control and suppresses tender weeds such as Chara and Nitella in the rice field.
 
• It releases plant growth regulators and vitamins which are very much required to enhance the growth of paddy crops.
 
• It helps increase crop yield and quality.
